CREATE TABLE "public"."aceptaciones_terminos" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fecha" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "versionTerminosId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."apelaciones" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'PENDIENTE' NOT NULL,
  "fecha" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fechaResolucion" timestamptz(3),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "incumplimientoId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "motivo" text NOT NULL,
  "resolucion" text,
  "resueltaPorCuentaId" uuid,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "apelaciones_estado_check_2419a1ff" CHECK ("estado" IN ('PENDIENTE', 'ACEPTADA', 'RECHAZADA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."categorias_recurso" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "tiempoMaximoPrestamoDias" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cuentas_acceso" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(254) NOT NULL,
  "habilitada" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "rol" text DEFAULT 'USUARIO' NOT NULL,
  "ultimoAcceso" timestamptz(3),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "cuentas_acceso_rol_check_cef7fc7b" CHECK ("rol" IN ('USUARIO', 'OPERADOR', 'ADMINISTRADOR'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."devoluciones" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fecha" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "observacion" text,
  "prestamoId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ejemplares" (
  "codigoInventario" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'DISPONIBLE' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "recursoId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ejemplares_estado_check_dcc20e51" CHECK ("estado" IN ('DISPONIBLE', 'PRESTADO', 'NO_DISPONIBLE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."evidencias_vinculacion" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "informacion" text NOT NULL,
  "solicitudRegistroId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."incumplimientos" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fecha" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "penalizacionAplicada" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "reglaId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "versionReglaId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."observaciones_ejemplar" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" text NOT NULL,
  "ejemplarId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "fecha" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prestamos" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "ejemplarId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'PLANIFICADO' NOT NULL,
  "fechaFin" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "fechaInicio" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "prestamos_estado_check_005a5bcd" CHECK ("estado" IN ('PLANIFICADO', 'ACTIVO', 'FINALIZADO'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recursos" (
  "categoriaId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(180) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reglas_uso" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "versionVigenteId" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sanciones" (
  "confianzaAnterior" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "confianzaPosterior" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVA' NOT NULL,
  "fechaFin" timestamptz(3),
  "fechaInicio" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "incumplimientoId" uuid,
  "reglaId" uuid,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "usuarioId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "versionReglaId" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sanciones_estado_check_5348962d" CHECK ("estado" IN ('ACTIVA', 'FINALIZADA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."solicitudes_registro" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'PENDIENTE' NOT NULL,
  "fechaSolicitud" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "identificadorInstitucional" character varying(80),
  "tipoUsuario" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "usuarioAprobadoId" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "solicitudes_registro_estado_check_e1c39414" CHECK ("estado" IN ('PENDIENTE', 'APROBADA', 'RECHAZADA')),
  CONSTRAINT "solicitudes_registro_tipoUsuario_check_70fac5a9" CHECK ("tipoUsuario" IN ('ESTUDIANTE', 'DOCENTE', 'ADMINISTRATIVO'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usuarios" (
  "confianza" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "identificadorInstitucional" character varying(80),
  "nombre" character varying(180) NOT NULL,
  "tipoUsuario" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "vinculacionVigente" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "usuarios_tipoUsuario_check_70fac5a9" CHECK ("tipoUsuario" IN ('ESTUDIANTE', 'DOCENTE', 'ADMINISTRATIVO'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."versiones_regla" (
  "consecuencia" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" text NOT NULL,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVA' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "numero" int4 NOT NULL,
  "penalizacionPorcentual" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "reglaId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "titulo" character varying(180) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "versiones_regla_estado_check_1cb87e59" CHECK ("estado" IN ('ACTIVA', 'INACTIVA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."versiones_terminos" (
  "contenido" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "numero" int4 NOT NULL,
  "titulo" character varying(180),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
